scope: Fixed three-robot high-level exploration behavior for subsequent independently authorized communication research; not a hardware or universal task-success certificate.

source.runtime_delta: Only dispatch existing requested cancels before missing/stale observation returns; original fresh-state order unchanged.

checkpoint.selection: Unchanged pre-TEST RL04 VAL selection; no TEST-based model reselection.

input_sources.poses: namespaced odometry header stamps + exact-time TF; retain last success at original stamp, reject pose age>2s
input_sources.task_state: actual task ownership and Nav2 feedback/results
input_sources.simulator_truth: not policy input; only independent sensor/evaluation/safety roles

actions.goal: index resolves to observed shared-map navigation target; transformed to robot-local map for NavigateToPose
actions.active_task: KEEP only; no policy CANCEL action
actions.idle_WAIT: only if sampled conditional mask has no available work
actions.low_level: Nav2 planning, control and avoidance; policy has no cmd_vel publisher

candidate_rules.selection: observed local reachability/approach eligibility and dedup before top5
candidate_rules.approach: only if shared group has no own-known locally reachable endpoint; original shared path prefix stops at own unknown boundary

decision_timing.feedback_consumption: Nav2 callbacks update observed feedback/result/ownership asynchronously; the policy consumes that state in the next scheduled joint snapshot.
decision_timing.active_task_ownership: KEEP only; retain existing token and accepted UUID, do not resend or replace the owned goal.

encoding_authority.semantics: Exact ordering, normalization/scales and whitelisted fields are defined by this pinned source, not reinterpreted by this document.

lifecycle.missing_or_stale_observation: No new policy selection or allocation. Dispatch already-requested cancellations after tick, independently of new-allocation freshness gate.
lifecycle.ownership: Retain task/token/accepted UUID until real Action terminal handling; dispatch is not completion.
lifecycle.timeout: 90 simulated seconds checked on scheduled callback, then asynchronous cancellation; not a physical stop deadline under transport loss.
lifecycle.stalled_WAIT: Use existing detectable stalled_wait and budget/safety termination rules, not an indefinite silent loop.

runtime.versions: ROS2 Humble; Gazebo Classic; custom SLAM source2.6.0; nav2_bringup source1.1.16 and system controller/planner1.1.20 (not one uniform Nav2 version).
runtime.copy_semantics: Only selected checkpoint and three original JSONs copied byte-for-byte to satisfy unchanged phase-relative loader. Historical formally_frozen=false fields and rl-04 origin paths remain historical. This manifest is current release authority. No READY/launch authorization copied.
runtime.execution_authorization: This freeze does not authorize another Gazebo, training or hardware run; existing boot requires separately established readiness.

inherited_evidence.Gazebo_scope: One historical 180sim knownEconA RL/Nav2/SLAM run and observed stop at ed4ca13a7ba8d874b9e5cf5f06c8665868a30f95; not a new run of the fixed missing/stale cancellation branch.

new_verification.lifecycle: Actual methods AST fixture; before and after 8 cases each, native0; unavailable-state timeout cancellation request, nonexpiry, ownership, no duplicate dispatch and unchanged fresh traces. Fake Action only.
new_verification.layout: Actual bwrap wrapper module-location and checkpoint-byte/path check, native0; no import of rclpy/torch or checkpoint deserialization.

known_limits: Only6new within-public-family geometries×2poses and one180sim knownEconA engineering round.
No demonstrated extra PPO generalization advantage over46e-v2;time/path differences cross zero.

permitted_outside_policy: Semantics-preserving serialization, timestamp/source preservation, transport replacement, delivery scheduling/compression and explicit deployment adapters.
Separate safety/transport mechanisms must be declared, identical across comparisons and must not choose alternative exploration goals.
requires_new_version: Weights, encode/normalization/ROI, candidate construction/ranking/filtering, masks/robot order, task/KEEP/WAIT semantics, thresholds, decision timing or core lifecycle changes.
forbidden: Retraining or hidden goal rewriting to improve frozen-policy communication comparisons.
Ideal ROS/shared-memory access to data not actually delivered through the constrained transport.
Discarding known failed ideal runs, changing TEST selection after results, or treating this freeze as scientific/hardware PASS.
change_rules.necessary_behavior_change: Issue a new version, independently reaccept it and rebuild all affected comparison baselines.

path_conventions: All artifact/evidence paths are workspace-root-relative; runtime_policy_source_sha256 and encoding_authority.source are relative to source.worktree. Original provenance JSON paths describe historical RL04 origin.
